stimulus.text: Paraphrase of Christopher Columbus, letter to Luis de Santangel, 1493. Columbus wrote that he had found many islands full of people, that the people were gentle and quick to learn, that the islands held gold and spices, and that he had taken possession of the lands for the king and queen of Spain.
stimulus.source_note: Paraphrase of a public-domain text; Columbus, letter to Luis de Santangel, 1493.

parts.prompt: Identify one claim Columbus makes about the lands or peoples he found.
Explain the purpose of Columbus in writing this letter.
Explain one limitation of this letter as evidence about Indigenous peoples.

instruction: Answer each part in your own words from the stimulus only. Do not open the question file.
